utterances.speaker: Noah

utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — the biggest needs so far are the loose porch step and the broken outlets, and the faucet is next if we have time. I’ll also note that I’m already on donations and check-ins, so we can track what’s been promised.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’ve got some spare tools and duct tape I can bring by the community shed this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Sure — I can send that over. I’ll check and get you the exact time and parking spot by the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. If you can sort the donations and pick up a few supplies, that would really help me out.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I can sort donations and grab a few supplies. Just send me the list when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Uli

utterances.speaker: Hana

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Mostly the basics—leaky faucets, broken shelves, and small electrical fixes. If you’ve got a specific repair in mind, I can help figure out if it fits.

utterances.text: Cleo: That sounds perfect—those basics are exactly what we’re gearing up for. I’m still watching our supplies, but any spare tools, screws, duct tape, or old extension cords would really help at the community shed this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can bring what I have and check if any neighbors can spare a few extras too. What time this afternoon should I drop them by?

utterances.text: Tess: I’ve heard the repair drive is at 10 AM over at the community center, and they still need volunteers plus tools like a wrench, tape, and spare screws. I’ll pass along any other details if I hear them.

utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — that’s perfect. I’ll keep organizing volunteers and make sure everyone knows to bring those tools to the community center on Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, Rosa — thanks for helping organize everyone. I’ll keep passing along any new updates if I hear more before Sunday.
